troubleshooting.title: Router Is Online but Devices Cannot Access the Internet
troubleshooting.shortdesc: All nodes show a white LED but connected devices cannot load websites or use apps.

condition.title: Condition
condition.p: One or more devices are connected to the Aria network and the node LEDs are solid white, but internet pages will not load and apps report no connection.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: Your modem has lost its connection to your internet service provider (ISP). This is the most common cause and is outside the router's control.

step.cmd: Locate your modem — the box connected directly to the cable or phone line coming into your home.
Unplug the modem's power cable, wait 30 seconds, and plug it back in.
Wait two minutes for the modem to fully restart and re-establish the ISP connection.
Check whether your devices can now access the internet. If not, contact your ISP directly.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: The Aria main node has lost its connection to the modem even though the LED is white. This can happen after a brief power fluctuation.

step.cmd: Unplug the Ethernet cable connecting your Aria main node to the modem, wait 10 seconds, and reconnect it firmly.
Open the Aria app and check whether the main node's status changes to green within one minute.
If the status does not change, restart the main node by unplugging its power cable, waiting 30 seconds, and plugging it back in.
